entries.note: UPU's posting event, which MaltaPost words as created. For an item from abroad it is the foreign post's posting, placed in its country.

entries.wording: Item arrived at the outgoing mail sorting centre
entries.note: A foreign post's outward office of exchange. Seen in archived replies of the tracking service.

entries.wording: Handed over to the airline / in transit
entries.note: Left the foreign post's outward office of exchange. Seen in archived replies of the tracking service.

entries.wording: Item arrived at inbound mail sorting centre
entries.note: Arrived in Malta, at the inward office of exchange or a post office.

entries.wording: Item to be submitted for clearance
Item undergoing border agency clearance. Awaiting presentation to border security
entries.note: The wording carries the reason MaltaPost gives.

entries.wording: Item returned from local Customs office
entries.note: Released by customs; the shared rules read the wording as a release too. Seen in archived replies of the tracking service.

entries.wording: Item held at inbound mail sorting centre. Awaiting payment of charges. Unsuccessful attempt-Recipient notified
entries.note: Held until the recipient pays the charges. A hold, not a movement: the item keeps the stage it had.
The recipient submitted the customs declaration online. Not a movement: the item keeps the stage it had.
The online payment of the charges went through. Not a movement: the item keeps the stage it had.
The recipient paid the charges online. Not a movement: the item keeps the stage it had.

entries.wording: Item departing from inbound mail sorting centre
Item to be forwarded to the delivery centre
Forwarded to the next processing centre
entries.note: Between MaltaPost's own centres and offices, on the way in or back; the tracking page's progress bar ignores it. The item keeps the stage it had.
On a delivery round. The shared rules do not stage the wording.

entries.wording: Item could not be processed further. Unsuccessful attempt-Recipient notified
entries.note: A failed delivery after which the recipient is notified. The reason that only points at the action is not read.

entries.wording: Item could not be processed further. Item not collected. Item returned to sender
entries.note: The action sends the item back to its sender; scans after it are on the way back.
Waiting at a post office for the recipient; the office is the pickup point.
